finalText:
**Redis died, and the cache loss took prod with it.**

| Time (UTC) | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` ([app.log:182](logs/app.log:182)) |
| 02:14:07 | Cache off, all reads hit the store direct |
| 02:29:12 | Queue passes the 500 cap ([app.log:647](logs/app.log:647)) |
| 02:31:44 | `JavaScript heap out of memory (request backlog)` |
| 02:31:52 | `api unresponsive, killing process group — service down` |

Redis never came back. All 13 reconnect tries got `ECONNREFUSED` on the same host. Everything else was fallout.

Next: check why `10.0.0.12:6379` refused connections.
